== Summary ==
Players Committee bag offered for pre-registration to the [[2023 World Championship]] and [[2023 European Championship]].

* '''Source:''' [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/401469157587025922/1125771062345474058 SWCCG Discord message], #cantina (4 July 2023)
* '''Date:''' posted 4 July 2023
* '''Description:''' Design drawing of the black PC cooler bag with the SWCCG Players Committee box mark.
* '''Also supplied by:''' Bill Bisco, 22 November 2026 (same file). Used on [[Players Committee marketing]].
